name: WeAct Black Pill V3.1 (STM32F411CEU6)
description: Best-value STM32 board: 100 MHz Cortex-M4F with FPU, 512 KB flash, USB-C and ROM DFU on a breadboard-friendly 2x20 board for about $6; the Blue Pill done right.
notes: F411 has a ROM USB DFU bootloader: hold BOOT0 and tap NRST. Blue LED on PC13 (active low), KEY button on PA0, 4-pin SWD header (3V3/SWDIO/SWCLK/GND) on the board.
V3.x uses a 25 MHz HSE crystal (set HSE_VALUE accordingly); the optional SPI flash footprint (U3) is unpopulated. The same board is also sold with STM32F401CC/CE.
Beware of counterfeit look-alikes without the 'WeAct Studio' logo and version silk. PA13/PA14 are on the SWD header only (not on the 2x20 headers).
Header positions come from the WeAct board-shape drawing (rows 15.2 mm apart, first pin 1.5 mm from the USB end).
